revisedDesign.summary: Keep R1's idea of one measurement SSOT, but rebuild it around the three-part shape of quanta's request, and let only the loop produce readings. (1) At the exact send seam the loop records a SentRequestRecord. Its partition has three parts: fixed chars (system blocks plus JSON of the visible specs); transcript length and a content digest of wm; and injected chars (request messages minus transcript, covering mentions, hook and context-change messages, and the trailing reminder). (2) Adapters report an optional promptTokens computed with the adapter's own cache convention, absent when the prompt-side count was not reported. (3) At one line in maybeCompact, after the microcompact pre-pass (also on the not-configured and breaker paths), and again at run end, the loop computes one branded ContextOccupancy. The formula subtracts the last request's injected estimate and excludes the next round's injected context by definition (D2), which is what removes both the +50k overcount and the system/tools undercount. (4) compactIfNeeded, the headroom advisory, the bg controller, the preflight query, the CLI holder and warning, the web canvas/readout/get_context_usage and the web StatusBar all consume that reading object and never compute. The warning verdict is one pure function whose result rides on the frame. (5) Window and threshold are resolved once per reading from the served port identity. (6) The last record lives in a per-session carry minted in createRuntimeSessionHost, which every surface goes through, and is written only by the root config. (7) TokenBaselineBox, triggerTokenCount, resolveWindowModel, snapshotToBreakdownInput, buildUsageBreakdownDefault and the web lib/context-warning.ts are deleted, not kept alongside.
revisedDesign.structuralMechanism: SSOT: `measureContextOccupancy(input)` in NEW src/agent/compaction/occupancy.ts is the only producer. Its brand constructor is module-private; the `ContextOccupancy` type is exported type-only from NEW src/shared/context-occupancy.ts so fenced renderers (CLI context-warning, which has no @/agent import) can type against it. A small AST census (T10, labeled static) forbids brand casts elsewhere. INVALID STATES ARE UNREPRESENTABLE: (a) `ProviderPromptTokens` brand is constructible only from an adapter usage event's optional `promptTokens` when it is a positive safe integer; absent means no anchor. (b) The anchor verdict is a closed union {kind:'anchored'} | {kind:'rejected', reason: 'no-record'|'provider-count-absent'|'served-model-changed'|'transcript-prefix-changed'|'partition-estimate-exceeds-provider-count'|'request-not-superset-of-transcript'}. Anchored iff the record exists, P is present, servedModelId === window.modelId, transcriptLength <= wm.length, sha256(role+content of wm[0..n)) === record.transcriptDigest, and P − ceil((fixedChars+injectedChars)/4) >= 0. Then total = P − ceil((fixedChars+injectedChars)/4) + ceil((fixedChars + charsOf(wm[n..]))/4); otherwise total = ceil((fixedChars + charsOf(wm))/4), with fixedChars taken from the latest record or labeled 'static-base'. No >=estimate gate and no model-name inference. (c) Categories: `messages: {kind:'residual', tokens} | {kind:'estimate-exceeds-measured', overBy}`. (d) Compaction: `{kind:'configured', thresholdTokens, source:'config'|'env'|'model-window'|'legacy-default'} | {kind:'not-configured'}`. (e) Warning verdict: `{level:'none'} | {level:'window', pct} | {level:'compaction', pct}` from `occupancyWarningOf(reading)`. CONVENTION SSOT: `LLM_SURFACE_IDS` const tuple in llm-route-types.ts (type derived) and `USAGE_CONVENTION_BY_SURFACE: Record<LlmSurfaceId,'cache-additive'|'cache-inclusive'>` in NEW src/shared/usage-prompt-tokens.ts, with a runtime drift guard; both @/llm (closed-port, @/shared only) and later @/observability can use it. WINDOW SSOT: `resolveOccupancyWindow({modelId, windowKey}, config.compaction)` reuses resolveThreshold and resolveModelWindow. The served identity comes from the routing authority's snapshot.port (resolveActiveModelId becomes resolveServedModel returning the port's contextWindowKey), and resolveWindowModel is deleted. PORTS: `contextOccupancyCarry` is minted per SessionHost in createRuntimeSessionHost and threaded per turn; session-bootstrap uses it only when isRootAgent(cfg), else a run-scoped carry. `onContextOccupancy` is one observer slot published only for the root config. WIRE PROOF: PreCompactRequestQuery gains `occupancy`, and T3 asserts q.occupancy === the published reading (identity), q.currentTokens === reading.totalTokens, and that the CLI holder and warning closure render that same reading. T4 proves the cross-prompt carry through the real session host. T8 makes canvas mirror drift fail CI.

userDecisions.question: D1: Ship the compaction-trigger semantic change default-on? It counts the fixed prefix on every round, keeps the anchor across prompts, subtracts the last request's injected context, removes the >=estimate gate, and uses the adapter-declared prompt count.
userDecisions.options: (a) Default-on after a receipt that can see it: T3/T4 scripted @file and cross-prompt scenarios (first-fire round and compaction count before/after), loop-d4-d5, and the 6-pick smoke labeled single-run-only. (b) A knob for one cycle. (c) Display-only now, leaving the trigger as it is.
userDecisions.recommendation: (a). A knob, or (c), re-creates two measurements, which is the defect class being removed.

userDecisions.question: D2: The next round's injected context (mentions, hook/context-change messages, trailing reminder) is resolved after the compaction trigger. How should the trigger treat it?
userDecisions.options: (a) Exclude it by definition and label it. The reading carries the last request's injected estimate, and both display and warning show the same number. (b) Reorder prepareTurnContext to resolve the dynamic inputs and compile before maybeCompact so it is counted exactly. That is a larger hot-path change; ordering with QUANTA_TYPED_EVENT_REPLAY compaction events is UNVERIFIED.
userDecisions.recommendation: (a) now. The reading exposes the per-request injected size, so measure the real CLI reminder distribution after C6 and decide (b) with data. o2 shows (a) equals actual-next-send minus the next round's injected context exactly.

userDecisions.question: D3: What should the /context head express?
userDecisions.options: (a) Projected total with '% until compaction' and '% of window', plus a detail line with the provider-reported last-request count and injected estimate. (b) Window % only. (c) Compaction % only.

userDecisions.question: D4: Categories and names.
userDecisions.options: Rename to System / Rules / Session context / Tools / MCP tools / Messages, with Messages as the residual via the union (note shown when estimates exceed measured), and buffer/free space as head annotations rather than segments. Or keep the current names.
userDecisions.recommendation: Adopt the renames and the union; the current 'Conversation' label is false.

userDecisions.question: D5: The web base composes no compaction config (static reading). What should web show?
userDecisions.options: (a) The reading says not-configured and web shows no threshold and no 'will compact' copy. (b) Compose the CLI compaction config on web, a separate measured behavior change.

userDecisions.question: D6: Persist the carry across --resume?
userDecisions.options: (a) Add it to the saved-session schema, validated by digest on load. (b) A resumed session starts at estimate until its first response.
userDecisions.recommendation: (b) now. The schema strips unknown keys today (saved-session-schema.ts:106-115).

userDecisions.question: D7: Also route /cost normalization through the adapter-declared convention instead of providerOf(model)?
userDecisions.options: (a) Yes, as C10 with the aug-30 owners (visible price change for OpenAI-compatible non-gpt ids with cached tokens). (b) Occupancy only.
userDecisions.recommendation: (a) as a separate commit after agreement.

userDecisions.question: D8: Fill the statusLine payload context_window in CC's object shape and exceeds_200k_tokens from the reading?
D9: Warning ratios.
userDecisions.options: (a) Keep 0.8 window / 0.9 compaction. (b) CC's threshold − 20k warn level.
userDecisions.recommendation: (a) in this cluster so the number fix is not mixed with a threshold change.

residualRisks: Under D2(a) the trigger excludes the next round's injected context. In steady state it undercounts by the trailing-reminder size relative to today's anchored rounds (probe reminder 53 tokens; real CLI size UNVERIFIED), and reactive PTL recovery stays the backstop.
The fixed-prefix part comes from the last request, so it goes stale for one round when plan mode or skill scope changes tool visibility (magnitude unmeasured).
chars/4 error in the injected subtraction lands in the anchored transcript term. The reading labels it, but it is not exact.

OpenAI Responses continuation (previous_response_id): whether usage.input_tokens covers the stored context is UNVERIFIED. If it reported only the delta, anchors would undercount; recommend an opt-in real-e2e check.
Which real vendors omit prompt-side counts is UNVERIFIED; they fall to the labeled estimate path.
Digest cost is 0.95 ms per 800KB of text and 10.31 ms for 13.8 MB with images per trigger (o3, n=20, one machine).
The carry is not persisted, so resumed sessions start at estimate. Host transcript edits between runs leave /context 'as of last turn' until the next run.
Web daemon 'no compaction' is static reading only; the reading's not-configured flag keeps the display honest either way.
Replay cassettes: whether jsonlReplayStore round-trips promptTokens is UNVERIFIED (T6 decides).
branch_search and side-conversation observer inheritance is mitigated by root-only publish and carry writes; CLI/web reachability of branch_search is UNVERIFIED.
dropOldestSalvage still fits against a messages-only estimate (compaction.ts:637; default-OFF), outside this packet.
Turn indicator 'N in' showing raw inputTokens (excluding Anthropic cache reads) is UNVERIFIED and outside this packet.
Concurrent-session commits touch shared hot files (wire-slots-runtime.ts, sdk/runtime/context.ts, context-binding base.ts); re-check HEAD before each commit and never rewrite refs.
C4 changes compaction timing. The receipt covers scripted multi-prompt scenarios and single-run bench, not live multi-hour CLI sessions.
